about: Name matches read by hand (T133). 'accepted': loose matches (generic words dropped) that name the same employer; 'rejected': matches that name another employer, or that could not be told apart by name. Read on 2026-10-21 (T133, T141; the US and Canada ones in T143, checked against the board's own jobs where unsure) by name, the company's job board slug and general knowledge, not against company records; where unsure, rejected. A rebuild lists new loose matches as unreviewed: add each here.
